doc: Conformance vectors for SCHEMA.md, executed by both renderers' suites.
One manifest, two harnesses: web/perf-driver.js (make web-perf) and
table-view-test.el (make test). A vector file declares a capability; a
harness runs the capabilities listed for it below and fails on any it does
not implement, so the manifest cannot quietly claim one that is missing.
The split is the honest one: table-view.el has no query grammar, so the
query vectors are the browser renderer's alone.

capabilities.sort: mount the view and read the row ids in display order
capabilities.render: mount the view and read a cell's displayed text and badge ink
capabilities.query: apply a filter query and read the row ids it leaves
capabilities.query-sort: apply a filter query and read the row ids in the order it leaves them
